MafiaNet vendored from https://github.com/MafiaHub/MafiaNet
Pinned: tag v0.10.0 (commit 0ab32ce519398443c122afb99597e1af1fb7fbd9)

Additionally vendored (not in v0.10.0): Source/src/RakVoice.cpp and
Source/include/mafianet/RakVoice.h, taken from MafiaNet master for voice chat
support. Opus and RNNoise are vendored separately under vendors/opus and
vendors/rnnoise rather than fetched, because the Framework uses no FetchContent.

LOCAL MODIFICATIONS -- DO NOT RE-VENDOR BLINDLY
===============================================
Three files below this directory now differ from upstream and carry changes the
Framework depends on. A plain re-copy from MafiaNet would silently delete the
entire voice relay protocol and reintroduce two real undefined-behaviour bugs.
Every item here must be re-applied on top of the new upstream, or upstreamed
first and the pin moved forward.

Modified files:
  Source/include/mafianet/RakVoice.h
  Source/src/RakVoice.cpp
  Source/include/mafianet/MessageIdentifiers.h

1. MessageIdentifiers.h -- ID_RAKVOICE_RELAY_DATA inserted directly after
   ID_RAKVOICE_DATA. This is a positional enum: the insertion shifts every id
   after it (ID_READY_EVENT_SET, ID_RPC_REMOTE_ERROR, the two-way-auth ids,
   ID_USER_PACKET_ENUM), so it is wire-breaking: a peer built against the old
   header misparses everything past ID_RAKVOICE_DATA. Re-vendoring must re-insert
   it at the same position.

   Because it is wire-breaking, any change to this file must ship as a MAJOR
   release. The Framework does not hand-edit VERSION -- CI raises it on merge
   from .github/bump_version.sh, which classifies the release by changed path.
   That script's major_paths array therefore lists this header explicitly; if
   this file is ever moved or renamed, that entry must move with it or the next
   wire break will silently release as a patch.

2. Relay protocol, from Framework commit e23ef4cc ("MafiaNet: add RakVoice relay
   mode and per-speaker output"):
     - Relay frame header and its derived offset constants in RakVoice.h
       (RAKVOICE_RELAY_OFFSET_*, RAKVOICE_RELAY_HEADER_SIZE), plus the
       RAKVOICE_RELAY_CHANNEL_TIMEOUT_MS reap constant.
     - SetRelayMode / SetRelayHost / SetRelayTarget / SetPerSpeakerOutput,
       RelayFrame, ReadRelayOrigin, OnRelayVoiceData.
     - GetOrCreateChannel and DecodeIntoChannel, extracted so relay speakers can
       be resolved and decoded without an OpenChannel handshake.
     - Per-speaker output path (ReceiveFrameFrom) instead of a single mixed
       output buffer.
     - Relay channel reap in Update(), since OnClosedConnection never fires for
       speakers that are peers of the server rather than of us.

3. Correctness fixes, from Framework commit e8464243 ("Voice: wire proximity
   relay into the server instance"). These fix real UB and must not be dropped:
     - Constructor now initialises zeroBufferedOutput and bufferedOutputCount,
       which were read uninitialised.
     - Update() early-outs when IsInitialized() is false, so a plugin attached
       without Init() (which is exactly how the relay host attaches) does not
       walk null codec state.
     - CloseVoiceChannel() guards on the channel actually existing.

4. Relay header format version byte, and encoder bitrate control, added in the
   final pre-merge fix pass:
     - RAKVOICE_RELAY_FORMAT_VERSION (value 1) written immediately after the
       packet id and validated by both ReadRelayOrigin and OnRelayVoiceData,
       which reject any other value silently. All later offsets are derived from
       it, so writer and readers cannot drift.
     - RAKVOICE_MAX_OPUS_PACKET_SIZE promoted from a RakVoice.cpp #define to a
       header constant so a relay host can bound inbound frame size.
     - SetEncoderBitrate() / defaultBitrate, applied via OPUS_SET_BITRATE at
       channel creation. Upstream never sets a bitrate at all.
     - Comment recording that the RNNoise denoise branch is unreachable at the
       Framework's 20ms/960-sample frame size.
